title: Reconcile a Half-Created Account
scenario: A crash hit the accounts task mid-way: the identity was created but the mailbox was not. A blind re-run would either duplicate the identity or skip the missing mailbox. Reconcile the partial state - keep what exists, complete only what is missing.
input: Accounts task for hire H-4021 crashed after creating the identity but before the mailbox. Current state: identityExists = true, mailboxExists = false. Rule: do NOT recreate the identity; complete only the missing mailbox. Record action = complete-missing, keep accountId acct-4021, and set state done once reconciled.
instructions: Record what exists: identityExists true, mailboxExists false.
Set action to complete-missing (finish only the missing piece).
Keep the existing accountId; do not recreate the identity.
Set state to done, then validate.
copilotPrompt: Encode a partial-failure reconciliation for accounts: identityExists true, mailboxExists false, action complete-missing (finish the mailbox only), keep accountId acct-4021, state done. Do not recreate the identity.
successMessage: Partial state reconciled. You completed the missing mailbox without recreating the identity.
editorHelper: Keep what exists; complete only what is missing.

sections.title: Failures land mid-task
sections.body: Real provisioning is several steps. A crash can leave you half-done: identity yes, mailbox no. The safe recovery is not 'run it all again' - it is reconcile: inspect what exists and finish the rest.

sections.title: Two wrong re-runs
sections.body: A naive retry either recreates the identity (a duplicate) or assumes everything failed and redoes finished work. Reconciliation avoids both by checking each sub-step.

sections.title: Complete-missing is the action
sections.body: The action name says the intent: keep the identity, create only the mailbox. Idempotency is not just at the task level - it is at every step that can partially fail.

sections.title: What you produce here
sections.body: A reconciled accounts result: what existed, what you completed, and a done state - no duplicate, no gap.

fieldGuide.meaning: Whether the identity was already created.

realWorld.soloRebuildPath: You'd check which parts of the account already exist and create only the missing ones, rather than re-running blind.

tools.powerAutomate: Get each resource; Condition per sub-step; create only the missing
tools.zapier: Find each part; create only where the lookup is empty

takeaway.heading: Partial state reconciled
points: You inspected what existed before acting on the failure.
You completed only the missing mailbox - no duplicate identity.
Idempotency held at the sub-step, not just the task level.
The reconciled account reached done cleanly.
The workflow can now recover from a mid-task crash without duplicating or skipping.
